name: io.github.mad4ms/comdirect-mcp
title: comdirect
description: Read-only access to comdirect bank accounts, transactions, depots and postbox documents.

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: comdirect API client id (alternatively stored in the OS keychain via `comdirect-mcp configure`)

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: comdirect API client secret (alternatively stored in the OS keychain via `comdirect-mcp configure`)

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: comdirect Zugangsnummer (alternatively stored in the OS keychain via `comdirect-mcp configure`)

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: comdirect PIN (alternatively stored in the OS keychain via `comdirect-mcp configure`)

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_MCP_PUSH_TAN_WAIT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for the push TAN approval if the client cannot show a confirmation dialog

environmentVariables.name: COMDIRECT_MCP_UNMASK_IBANS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to return counterparty IBANs unmasked
